name: Ethnic democracy
summary: Ethnic democracy is a regime type, theorised by Sammy Smooha and applied above all to Israel, in which an ethnic nation owns and shapes the state while minorities receive citizenship, voting rights and some collective rights but in inferior or incomplete form. The state is democratic in procedure, with elections, protest and minority parties, yet it uses controls such as immigration preference for the core nation, land policy, surveillance and the banning of parties that reject its ethnic character to keep the majority secure. Defenders present it as a pragmatic lesser evil or a temporary necessity; critics call it a contradiction or a mask for ethnocracy.
scope: Profile of the regime model as set out by Sammy Smooha (2002 'mini-model') with Juan Linz's earlier coinage and the Israeli archetype as the main case, plus Estonia, Latvia and Slovakia as other cited applications. It answers as a committed proponent of an ethnically defined democratic state would, in Smooha's 'standard' subtype, not as a hardline or non-democratic variant. Because it is a descriptive model rather than a full political program, most statements outside ethnicity, citizenship, security and the state are left at low confidence or neutral.

keyFigures.name: Sammy Smooha
keyFigures.role: Israeli sociologist who developed the ethnic democracy model from 1989 and applied it to Israel

keyFigures.name: Juan José Linz
keyFigures.role: Political scientist who introduced the term 'ethnic democracy' in 1975

universal-healthcare.rationale: The model grants minorities social rights but says nothing on health financing; ethnic democracies range from state-run systems to insurance models.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Wage policy is outside the model, which concerns who owns the state; adherents on left and right both exist.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Ethnic democracy is defined by ethnic ownership of the state, not by economic doctrine, so no market stance follows.

public-ownership.rationale: No source ties the model to nationalisation or privatisation; the only economic point raised is Jewish state and public-body control of land.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Redistribution is not part of the model; the inequality it addresses is between ethnic groups, not classes.

unions-good.rationale: Smooha mentions Arab participation in the Histadrut union federation but takes no position on whether unions are good.

property-fundamental.rationale: The model describes extensive state land control and confiscation of Arab land, which cuts against absolute property rights, yet it also protects citizens' rights generally.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Business regulation never enters the model; no commitment can be inferred.

cut-welfare.rationale: Smooha notes Jews resent Arab use of family allowances but the model itself grants social rights to all citizens and does not call for cuts.

worker-ownership.rationale: Nothing in the model concerns firm ownership.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Security surveillance of the minority by the secret service is a named control measure of the model and justified as defence of national security.

legalize-drugs.rationale: A social-policy question the ethnic-democracy literature does not address.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: The model bans parties and incitement that threaten the state's ethnic character, but adherents are not documented as favouring general hate-speech law.

strong-leader.rationale: The model requires a functioning electoral democracy with alternating governments, so a leader bypassing gridlock sits uneasily with it.

state-harmful.rationale: The ethnic nation appropriates the state as its tool for security, demography and culture, so the state is essential and not harmful.

limit-guns.rationale: Gun control is not discussed; only the state's security role is stressed.

empower-police-military.rationale: The model keeps a large security apparatus and a permanent emergency to contain perceived threats from the minority and neighbours.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Moral-liberty issue unrelated to the model.

decide-locally.rationale: The core nation shapes the state centrally, and local minority-majority areas are seen as a threat, so devolution is not favoured.

rehabilitation.rationale: Penal philosophy is not part of the model.

traditional-family.rationale: Smooha notes demographic competition and endogamy but the model does not endorse a family doctrine.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Not addressed; adherents divide along ordinary liberal-conservative lines.

abortion-legal.rationale: Not addressed by the model, though demographic worries could push some adherents toward restriction.

more-religion-public.rationale: Orthodox Judaism has a central role in Israel, but Estonia or Slovakia do not use religion; the model is not uniformly religious.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: The model treats the minority's grievances as incomplete rights to be eased gradually, and does not endorse active historical redress.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Not touched by the ethnic-democracy literature.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: The ethnic nation shapes the state's symbols, laws and language, and making the state Jewish in culture is described as Zionism's central objective.

gradual-change.rationale: Smooha describes the regime as changing by degrees from hardline toward standard and improved subtypes, but does not make gradualism a principle.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Immigration is selective: Jewish immigration is encouraged while non-Jews are kept out, so a general reduction is not implied.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Smooha lists international intervention on behalf of minorities as a threat to the stability of ethnic democracy.

free-trade.rationale: No trade policy is part of the model.

nation-first.rationale: The state is a tool for the core nation's interests, which suggests putting them first, though global cooperation is not discussed.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: The model says nothing on foreign wars; it only notes hostility to outside human-rights interference at home.

open-borders.rationale: Closure is a mark of ethnic nations, and immigration controls that guarantee majority demography are a stability condition.

limit-growth.rationale: Environmental economics is outside the model.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Climate policy lies outside the sources on ethnic democracy; adherents divide on it like other citizens.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: The model has no view on technological progress; this is a general worldview question for adherents.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Energy policy is not part of the model.

revolution-justified.rationale: The model presumes a stable, committed democracy, but it does not discuss revolution explicitly.

experts-over-public.rationale: No source indicates a view on technocracy.

socialized-markets.rationale: Economic ownership forms are not addressed.

land-value-tax.rationale: Not addressed; land policy in the model concerns ethnic control, not taxation.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Inheritance tax is a class-economy issue; the ethnic-democracy sources cover only ethnic rights and control.

basic-income.rationale: A welfare design question; the sources name no stance, and adherents sit on both sides.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Trade protection is not discussed in the model; Smooha mentions only Israel's Western orientation.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Not addressed; Smooha only notes state allocation of land and resources favouring the majority.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Distribution of property among owners is not part of the model, which concerns ethnic control of land.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Nothing in the model supports abolishing money; it fits within normal democratic capitalism, so disagreement is inferred.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Monetary institutions are untouched by the ethnic-democracy literature.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: State-run wage bodies are not discussed; the model's organising principle is ethnic, not occupational.

one-party-rule.rationale: The model requires competitive politics, alternating governments and Arab parties that may contest elections.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Democratic institutions are central to the model; a hereditary head of state is not discussed and sits poorly with it.

democracy-best.rationale: Majority commitment to democracy is a condition for emergence, though adherents see the ethnic nation's survival as potentially overriding it.

direct-votes.rationale: Not addressed; the model's democracy is representative.

workers-councils.rationale: The model assumes parliamentary democracy with the Knesset or equivalent as the arena for minority and majority politics.

right-to-secede.rationale: Minority secessionism is a feared threat that justifies controls, so a regional right to secede is rejected.

natural-rulers.rationale: The core ethnic nation claims ownership of the state and rules it, which resembles this claim in group terms, though the model is formally democratic.

political-violence-never.rationale: The model builds on state security measures and a majority mobilised for defence, not on pacifism.

war-builds-character.rationale: The sources describe mobilisation against threats but make no claim that war improves a nation.

separate-church-state.rationale: In the Israeli case religion is used to define membership and regulate marriage, so strict separation is not part of it.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Orthodox authority on who is a Jew is accepted in Israel but the regime is democratic, so law as such is not scriptural.

private-courts-defense.rationale: The state is the ethnic nation's instrument for security and defence, so privatising them is incompatible.

military-superiority.rationale: Smooha says the Jewish state must keep high military capability to survive in a hostile region.

ethnic-nation.rationale: The model begins from an ethnic nation with common descent, language and culture that owns the state and homeland.

class-struggle-history.rationale: The model sees ethnic conflict as the main cleavage, not class.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Group inequalities are accepted as part of ethnic ascendancy, and nothing in it promotes equal outcomes.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Smooha's conditions treat an indigenous core group as favourable, but the minority's land claims are seen as threats, so adherents are mixed.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Not addressed; the logic of national interest first suggests scepticism.

civilizational-union.rationale: The model centres a single ethnic nation's own state, not union across states.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Personal ethics of self-interest are outside a model of group-based state ownership.

duties-before-rights.rationale: The ethnic nation takes precedence over the citizenry in the model, yet citizens' individual rights are also guaranteed.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: Environmental ethics is not covered by any source on this ideology.

limit-population.rationale: The model is anxious about demographic majority, so limiting population growth is unlikely to be favoured by the core group.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Not addressed; the model assumes modern state institutions.

accelerate-technology.rationale: The model says nothing on the pace of technological change.

human-enhancement.rationale: Bioethics is not addressed by the ethnic-democracy literature.

algorithmic-government.rationale: AI in administration is outside the model's concerns.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: The security apparatus surveilling the minority would resist citizens' uncrackable communications.

restore-past-order.rationale: Not addressed; adherents range from progressives to conservatives.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Smooha defends the model as a pragmatic compromise, but no general stance on ideology is given.

direct-action.rationale: The model assumes parliamentary channels; Smooha praises the minority's protest only as permitted struggle within democracy.

means-match-ends.rationale: Smooha defends the regime pragmatically as a lesser evil, not on a principle that means mirror ends.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Incompatible with a modern state controlling territory and security.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Not addressed; the model assumes a normal modern economy.

distribute-by-need.rationale: A communist distribution principle that the model neither endorses nor discusses.

production-for-use.rationale: Economic organisation is not part of the model; ethnic ownership of the state is its core.

profit-exploitation.rationale: The model gives no support to Marxist economics; ethnic, not class, domination is its concern.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Contradicts the model's requirement of electoral democracy with alternation.

collective-farming.rationale: Agricultural organisation is not addressed; land politics here concern ethnic control.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Wars are explained through ethnic and national conflict in the model, not capitalism.

taxation-theft.rationale: The state is the essential instrument of the ethnic nation, so denying its taxing authority fits poorly.

harm-principle.rationale: The model restricts minority freedoms on grounds of perceived threat, which goes beyond harm, yet it protects liberties generally.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Smooha stresses that the minority gets some collective rights and that the ethnic nation, not just individuals, is the state's cornerstone.

conscription.rationale: Israel's military service mobilises the majority; Smooha notes minority exemption as a control device.

exit-over-voice.rationale: Minority voice and struggle are central to the model, and the state wants its citizens inside.

state-as-business.rationale: The state serves the ethnic nation, not customers.

positive-liberty.rationale: Not addressed beyond social rights granted to citizens.

media-academia-power.rationale: The sources do not claim media or universities rule; adherents vary with national politics.

hereditarian-race.rationale: The ethnic nation rests on common descent and culture, but no source claims genetic ability differences.

organic-representation.rationale: Representation is through Knesset-style party elections in the model.

total-state.rationale: The model keeps civil and political rights, protest and a civil society, which excludes totalitarianism.

national-rebirth.rationale: Zionism included revival, but the model itself is about an established regime.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Smooha says keeping the Jewish majority requires withdrawing from the West Bank and Gaza, so expansion into populated land is disfavoured.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Contrary to the democratic institutions required.

bound-labor.rationale: Contrary to citizenship rights that the model grants.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: An epistemology question with no connection to the model's claims about state and ethnicity.

universal-morality.rationale: Smooha cites universal minority-rights documents as compatible, but the model puts the ethnic nation above universalism.

single-common-good.rationale: The model openly sees majority and minority interests as distinct, with the majority's prioritised.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Smooha's archetype case is Israel as the Jewish and democratic state built by Zionism, but the general model also covers non-Jewish core nations such as Estonia and Slovakia.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: Smooha describes the Law of Return as a bulwark of ethnic ascendancy and says diaspora members of the ethnic nation are preferred to non-members.

revive-national-language.rationale: Hebrew is the Israeli archetype's dominant official language and base of Jewish culture, and Estonia's language policy is also cited, though not every case involves a revival.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Firm governance is not addressed; the model's concern is ethnic ownership of the state.

school-vouchers.rationale: Smooha describes separate publicly funded Arab schools but no voucher principle.

economic-freedom.rationale: Not addressed; the model treats political order, not economics, as primary.

rule-by-example.rationale: The model relies on statutes, courts and security legislation rather than moral exemplars.

national-self-determination.rationale: The ethnic nation exercises its full right to self-determination in an appropriated state, and Gavison grounds the model in that right.

force-without-un.rationale: Not addressed directly; the sense of existential threat and the condition of non-intervention suggest wariness of UN constraints.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Not addressed; Orthodox religion is entangled in Israel's membership rules.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Social rights attach to citizenship in the model, and Smooha notes non-Jews outside it are not naturalised, which implies benefits for citizens.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Welfare conditions are not discussed, only that citizens receive social rights.

class-collaboration.rationale: Not addressed; the model's solidarity is ethnic.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Cultural heritage and symbols of the ethnic nation are central to the state, so sacrificing them is rejected.

dominated-front.rationale: The states in the model seek ties with the West, as Smooha says Israel did, rather than anti-Western fronts.

workers-nation.rationale: The unit of solidarity is the ethnic nation, but no source takes up the working-class question.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Gender roles are not part of the model; Smooha notes only religious regulation of marriage.

ban-interest.rationale: Not addressed; the model assumes a normal Western-style economy.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: The model grants the minority citizenship and extensive rights and rejects racial classification of that kind, though Arabs live mostly in separate communities by custom.

state-class-instrument.rationale: The model sees the state as an instrument of the ethnic nation, not a class.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Energy production is outside the sources on this ideology.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Smooha says outsiders can be admitted via language and cultural assimilation, though minorities already citizens are not pressured to assimilate.

elite-replacement.rationale: The model worries about demographic swamping by minorities but describes immigration policy as state-controlled, not an elite plot.

proportional-representation.rationale: Israel uses PR but the model does not require it; Estonia and Slovakia vary.

national-mission.rationale: The model is about the nation's own state and security, not spreading a form of government abroad.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Feminist structural analysis is not addressed by the model.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Anti-elite populism is not part of the model, which presumes working democratic institutions.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: The model keeps individual rights for citizens and offers no eugenic doctrine.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: The state treats security services as essential and the state inquiry into the 2000 killings was seen as exceptional, so broad legal accountability for past abuses is not a tenet.

night-watchman-state.rationale: The state is expected to mobilise the nation, control land and shape culture, not merely guard property.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Smooha lists biological dilution and mixed marriage as threats and describes laws that enforce national and religious endogamy.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Non-members of the ethnic nation have rights inferior in some respects to members, in direct tension with equal rights, though they keep individual rights.

socialism-one-country.rationale: A Marxist debate with no bearing on the ethnic-democracy model.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: Smooha presents Zionism as return to an ancestral homeland, though he acknowledges the displacement of Palestinians in 1948.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Smooha says the law on separate religious communities, which regulates marriage and divorce, is used to maintain endogamy.

restrict-conversion.rationale: Smooha notes conversion as a route of admission to the ethnic nation, but no source takes a view on restricting it.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: A religious-cultural policy not addressed by the model and not tied to any case it covers.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Not addressed; Jewish state schools in Israel include religious streams.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: The model assumes a threatened state, but socialist theory is not addressed.

consent-of-governed.rationale: The model is a democracy, and citizens including the minority vote, though Smooha notes the minority cannot fully confer legitimacy.

trade-surplus.rationale: Mercantilist trade aims are not discussed in the sources.

population-transfer.rationale: Smooha defends ethnic democracy as superior to ethnic cleansing and involuntary population transfer as a way to manage conflict.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: The model rests on state security and military mobilisation, not on libertarian non-aggression.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Social Darwinist claims are not made in the model, which stresses compromise between majority and minority.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Smooha calls ethnic democracy a defensive democracy designed to outlaw highly menacing groups and notes Israeli laws barring parties that deny its Jewish character.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: The model accepts an ethnic majority's ascendancy over minority citizens, which is a standing power over them.

separated-powers.rationale: Smooha credits a stronger Supreme Court and public scrutiny of security services as part of democratisation, which implies checks.

vanguard-party.rationale: Contrary to the competitive democracy the model requires.

priority-to-poor.rationale: A social-ethics claim with no basis in the model, whose inequality concerns ethnic groups.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: A British housing policy issue not covered by the sources.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Not addressed; the minority's strikes are described as tolerated protest.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Smooha mentions higher Arab birth rates as a demographic worry, not as the cause of poverty.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: The model treats non-members as a threat to the integrity of the ethnic nation, with demographic swamping among the fears.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Not discussed; elections and party politics are central.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Smooha says Israel operates in a permanent state of emergency with powers to suspend civil rights to prevent security infractions, though use against Arabs has become less frequent.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: Price regulation is outside the model.

party-controls-media.rationale: The model protects a diverse media and Arab media outlets, so state or party control is rejected.

party-commands-army.rationale: Not part of a democratic ethnic state.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Smooha says Israel's naturalisation law is virtually unused and non-Jews are kept out to preserve the majority, which implies a high bar for outsiders.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: A populist pay rule not addressed by the model.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Internal party rules are not part of the ethnic-democracy model.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: The core nation exercises full self-determination in its own state; pooling sovereignty is not addressed.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Executive-military arrangements vary across Israel, Estonia and Slovakia and the model takes no stance.

church-by-bishops.rationale: Church governance is irrelevant to the model's concern with ethnic nations.

clerical-rule.rationale: The regime is democratic and secular in structure even where Orthodox rabbinate has authority over membership.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: The state is the ethnic nation's mobilisation tool, so defeatism is opposed.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: The model protects civil liberties, with limits mostly security-related.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Term limits are not part of the model; regimes of this kind differ.

recall-officials.rationale: Recall mechanisms are not addressed; the model assumes ordinary elections.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Smooha says Israel joined the Western bloc and depends on Western support, so ending alliances is not favoured.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Not addressed; no support follows from the model.

people-in-arms.rationale: The state's armed forces are the main instrument of security in the model.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: A cultural-romantic claim that the sources do not make.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: The model is concerned with diaspora and homeland, but does not discuss reunification of states.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Anti-intellectual claims are not part of the model.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: The state privileges one culture, though Smooha does not claim cultures differ in rank.

death-penalty.rationale: Israel and the other cited cases differ on capital punishment, and the model is silent.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: School curriculum on sexuality is not addressed.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Science curriculum is outside the model; Orthodox pressure exists in Israel but is not part of it.

restrict-pornography.rationale: A morality-law question the model does not take up.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: The model separates citizenship from membership in the ethnic nation and favours descent-based admission such as the Law of Return, but grants citizenship to residents too.

minority-language-support.rationale: Smooha lists free use of Arabic, Arabic schools and Arabic media partly funded by the state as collective linguistic rights of the minority.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Smooha says minority religious institutions are funded and protected, yet no general exemption principle is stated.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: A Millian liberty claim not addressed by the model.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: Debt politics are outside the sources.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: The model treats national statehood as the main aim, not economic transformation.

constituent-assembly.rationale: Constitution-making method is not discussed; Israel has no single constitution but the model does not call for one.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: The model keeps political freedoms and restricts them only for security reasons.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Global redistribution is not addressed by the model.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Smooha stresses high military capability for survival in a hostile region, though nuclear weapons are not discussed.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Presidential election method is not part of the model.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Smooha says the Jewish majority consensus requires withdrawing from the West Bank and Gaza to keep Israel Jewish and democratic.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Not addressed beyond state control of land for national purposes.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: A Marxist historical dispute unrelated to the model.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Environmental regulation philosophy is not addressed.

collective-defense.rationale: The model depends on Western alliance support, but no source addresses mutual defence clauses.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Smooha calls the post-1967 territories occupied but adherents of the model differ on legal framing.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: In Israel Orthodox religious bodies have state-backed power, so the model does not curb religious institutions.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: Head-of-state role differs between cases and the model takes no stance.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Minority secessionism is a feared threat and justifies controls, so force to prevent it follows by inference.

region-keeps-system.rationale: The model fears minority autonomy lest it be used for secessionism and denies cultural autonomy for that reason.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Contrary to a democratic ethnic state.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Tax design is unaddressed by the model.

character-from-environment.rationale: The ethnic nation rests on descent and culture, but no source takes a nature-nurture position on individuals.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Rule of law is described as reduced in ethnic democracy but is still a defining democratic element.

mixed-constitution.rationale: A classical constitutional theory the sources do not discuss.

leader-cult.rationale: The model rests on elections and civil society, not a leader cult.

equal-parenting.rationale: A family-law issue not covered by the model.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: A Maoist doctrine irrelevant to the model.

land-redistribution.rationale: The model's land politics concern ethnic control, and Smooha describes confiscation of Arab land as a criticised feature, not land reform for farmers.

refugee-return.rationale: Smooha lists denial of the right of return to Palestinian refugees as a pillar of Israeli ethnic democracy and a condition of keeping a Jewish majority.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: The model includes kin diasporas but ethnic democracies like Israel have not pursued such claims in its sources.

apostasy-punishable.rationale: Contrary to the civil and political rights the model grants.

women-must-cover.rationale: Not part of the model, which grants individual rights.

common-currency.rationale: Monetary union is not discussed, only Western orientation in general.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: The model centres a single nation's own state with closure, not cross-border unity.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: Smooha says the standard subtype funds minority schools and media but denies cultural autonomy, while the improved subtype grants it, so adherents are split.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: The core nation's own state exists because diaspora minorities were not secure, and Smooha treats Israel as the refuge for persecuted Jews.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: The model explains regimes by ethnic nationalism and threat perception.

ban-cartels.rationale: Antitrust is outside the model's scope.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Smooha credits an active Supreme Court with defending rights and rulings such as Katzir, though the majority keeps the upper hand.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Gender quotas are not part of the model.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: The states in the model seek integration with the West.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Trade-treaty standards are unaddressed by the sources.

moral-incentives.rationale: Not addressed; no support in the model.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: The model is a democratic regime that treats armed minority groups as a security threat.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Aristocracy is not an issue in the model; the cases are modern republics.

history-own-civilization.rationale: The ethnic nation shapes symbols and culture in the state, which implies national history in schools.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: The model is about the nation's own self-rule and not rule over others.

patriotic-education.rationale: The state mobilises the majority around national symbols, flag and anthem, which implies teaching loyalty to them.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Smooha describes affirmative action to co-opt Arabs into civil service, yet the model also favours the majority; adherents split.

public-money-creation.rationale: Monetary reform is outside the model.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: A Marxist crisis debate with no bearing on the model.

former-empire-influence.rationale: Post-imperial influence is not part of the model; the cases are nation-states.

delink-world-market.rationale: The states in the model seek Western integration.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: A Marxist-Leninist theory irrelevant to the model.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: The state itself discriminates by ethnicity, but Smooha criticises discrimination by private actors as a weakness of democracy, not an aim.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Not addressed; Israel has no single entrenched bill and the model does not require one.

colonial-treaties-void.rationale: Colonial borders are not discussed; the model takes the existing state as given.

elective-rulers.rationale: The model is an electoral democracy in which the majority elects rulers.

minority-veto.rationale: Smooha contrasts ethnic democracy with consociational democracy, which uses veto power, and says it falls short of such mechanisms.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: Resistance theory is not addressed; the model's democracies change rulers by election.

parliament-supreme.rationale: The majority acts through parliament, in Smooha's account of Israeli politics, though monarchy is not discussed.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: Animal ethics is outside the sources.

animal-use-humane.rationale: Animal welfare policy is not discussed.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: An aristocratic duty of care is not in the model.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: The model assumes a mobilised majority; withdrawal is not discussed.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: A Frankfurt School claim not addressed by the model.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: A Gramscian claim irrelevant to the ethnic-democracy model.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: Dependency theory is not part of the model.

native-born-offices.rationale: The model grants political rights to all citizens and the minority holds Knesset seats, so office is not restricted to native-born.

party-own-road.rationale: A communist-movement question unrelated to the model.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Not addressed; Smooha notes Israel's dependence on Western aid.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Irredentism is not described in the model for its main cases, which stress homeland already held.

indigenous-political-leadership.rationale: Not addressed; Smooha lists indigenous core groups as one favourable condition but not as a rule.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: Constitutional foundations differ across cases and no source takes up anti-fascism.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: The sources contain no stance on comparing fascism and communism.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: American historical debate outside the model.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: Monuments politics is not covered, beyond the state symbols of the core nation.

male-disadvantage-attention.rationale: Gender-equity advocacy is not part of the model.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Smooha argues ethnic democracy is a distinct form that need not follow Western civic models, which resembles this claim.

military-guardian-role.rationale: Smooha notes military and security services as control instruments, but no political guardianship role.

filial-duty.rationale: Family ethics are not part of the model.

office-by-exam.rationale: Civil-service recruitment method is not discussed.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: Industrial policy on foreign ownership is not discussed by the sources.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: In Israel divorce is regulated by religious communities, so no-fault divorce is not part of the model.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Not part of the representative democracy described.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Smooha notes state and Jewish public bodies control most land, but this is for ethnic purposes, not use-based tenure.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: The model assumes a functioning elected legislature, which implies budget control.

single-official-language.rationale: Arabic is an official language in Israel and the minority has state-funded Arabic schooling, though Hebrew dominates.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: State and Jewish bodies control land to protect the ethnic nation, which suggests limits on outside ownership.

disparate-impact-discrimination.rationale: The model accepts structural ethnic advantage and does not test policy by group outcomes.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Cultural criticism of consumption is not in the model.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: Covert war policy is not discussed.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: The model stresses non-interference and the right of a state to run its own affairs.

corporate-influence.rationale: Lobbying is not part of the model's concerns.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Smooha reports that Arab NGOs' activities abroad are regarded as hostile and subversive by Jewish public and media, and external patrons are a feared threat.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: The model fears demographic swamping and seeks a lasting majority, which favours encouraging majority births over mass immigration of non-members.

residents-only-property.rationale: Not addressed; the model restricts land by ethnicity, not by residence.

democratic-peace.rationale: The model is not about spreading democracy abroad or about peace theory.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: The state's authority and defence of its ethnic character rely on citizens' obedience.

non-intervention.rationale: The model's stability needs the international community not to intervene in the state's treatment of minorities.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: The minority is seen as a security and demographic threat and possible secessionists, but the model does not hold that it is secretly conspiring.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Marriage law enforces national and religious endogamy in the Israeli case.

public-access-to-information.rationale: Smooha mentions growing public scrutiny of security services; no information-access right is set out.

local-production.rationale: Localism in trade is not discussed.

informal-organisation.rationale: The model is built on parties, a parliament and organised civil society.

national-law-over-international.rationale: The core nation shapes law and symbols itself and stability depends on lack of international interference.

religious-nation.rationale: Smooha says ethnicity, religion and peoplehood are intertwined for Jews, but the general model defines the nation by descent, language and culture.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: The model assumes a sovereign nation-state with its own self-determination.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: The majority controls the national budget and Smooha notes concern over minority regions' state allocations.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: A socialist property distinction irrelevant to the model.

defeat-communism.rationale: Cold War positioning is not part of the model.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: Public-service delivery design is not addressed.

religion-illusion.rationale: The model treats religion as part of ethnic identity in Israel, so a purely dismissive view is unlikely.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: A Marxist historical claim with no connection to the model.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: A socialist-feminist claim the model does not address.

socialized-care.rationale: Public childcare is unaddressed by the model.

purge-loanwords.rationale: Smooha notes Hebrew displacing foreign languages in Israeli-born generations but not purism.

treaties-binding.rationale: Indigenous treaty law is not covered, though the model discusses minority land loss.

cooperative-communities.rationale: The model assumes a mobilised nation-state, not small cooperative communities.

majority-settlement.rationale: Smooha lists large-scale Jewish settlement of Arab areas to undo Arab territorial contiguity, and Galilee concerns, as a state measure of the model.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Third-position economics is not part of the model.

historical-land-claim.rationale: The ethnic nation considers its territory an exclusive homeland, and Smooha grounds Zionism in Jewish ancestral ties to the Land of Israel.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Smooha's account of Jewish statehood treats antisemitism and diaspora persecution as the reason for the Jewish state; denial is outside that account.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Sexual law is outside the model; Israel and Estonia have decriminalised it, but the model does not address it.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Smooha says minority citizens may conduct an intense struggle for equal rights without state repression, and that Arab organisations are not banned.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: The model grants civil rights and is not religiously enforced.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: The model concerns a nation's own state, not overseas rule.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: The model sees an Islamic Movement within the minority as a security concern.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: The model is democratic and treats Islamist rejectionism as a threat.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Participatory structures are not part of the model's representative democracy.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: The model's analysis centres on ethnic dominance and not on intersecting oppressions.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Trans rights are outside the model.

assisted-dying.rationale: Medical ethics is outside the model.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: The model offers no comment on political spectrum framing.

alienated-labor.rationale: A Marxist concept unrelated to the model.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Smooha describes Arab states as hostile to Israel and the Islamic Movement as rejectionist, but does not claim Islam is incompatible with Western values.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Authority in the model rests on democratic procedures and an ethnic nation, not God.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: State dress rules are not addressed; the model covers religion only as marker of membership.

ban-nda-harassment.rationale: Workplace-law reform is outside the model.

social-market-economy.rationale: Not addressed; Smooha notes social rights for citizens only.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Smooha says the Jewish state must keep high military capability to survive, and the armed forces are central to its security.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Smooha says Israel opted to join the Western bloc immediately after 1948.

dynastic-succession.rationale: The model is an electoral democracy.

refuse-lender-austerity.rationale: Debt politics are outside the model.

property-franchise.rationale: All permanent residents are to be granted citizenship and political rights, so property qualifications do not fit.

domination-women-nature.rationale: An ecofeminist claim not in the model.

reification.rationale: A Marxist concept irrelevant to the model.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: A socialist critique of press freedom not addressed in the model.

promulgated-standing-laws.rationale: Smooha treats rule of law as reduced but present in ethnic democracy, so government by public laws is assumed.

racial-franchise.rationale: Smooha defines ethnic democracy as granting citizenship with political rights to all permanent residents, including minority voting and Knesset seats, so franchise is not limited to the core group.

online-participation.rationale: Digital democracy is not part of the model.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Israel's law on separate religious communities regulates marriage and enforces religious endogamy as a means of preserving Jewish identity.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: Smooha reports Jewish boycott of Arab businesses as a backlash, but not as a principle of the regime.

citizens-assembly.rationale: Sortition is not part of the model's electoral democracy.

reinterpret-religion.rationale: Religious reform is not addressed, though Orthodoxy is entrenched in Israeli membership rules.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: A republican-economic claim not in the model.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: Military personnel policy on sexuality is not addressed.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Religion is intertwined with nationality for Jews and enforced in marriage law, so state atheism contradicts it.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: The model relies on police and security services to manage the minority threat.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: Smooha says even improved ethnic democracy falls short of power-sharing and proportionality, and the majority keeps control of the state.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Poor-relief arrangements are not part of the model.

term-limits.rationale: Term limits are not addressed by the model.

vote-delegation.rationale: Liquid democracy is not part of the model.

existential-risk-priority.rationale: Not addressed; the model's own priority is national survival.

women-in-religious-leadership.rationale: Internal religious office is not addressed.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Marital authority is not addressed in the model.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: The model separates citizens from non-members, and non-citizens keep fewer political rights.

abolish-ip.rationale: Intellectual property law is outside the model.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Not addressed; the state mobilises the majority but through ordinary institutions.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.rationale: Nuclear basing is not discussed in the sources.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: Foreign basing is not discussed in the sources.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Recognition politics are not addressed in the model.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: A socialist-distributist claim not addressed by the model.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: The model's state is built on security and defence of the nation against threats.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: The ethnic nation claims common descent and historical homeland ties, and Smooha traces Jewish sovereignty back to antiquity, though continuity is not stated as doctrine.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: A theory of sex not related to the model.

no-fixed-category-of-women.rationale: A feminist theory dispute outside the model.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: The state symbols and days of commemoration are those of the core nation, which implies honouring its fallen.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: The model treats politics as ethnic and security management, not spiritual struggle.

homeland-cultural-centre.rationale: Smooha describes the homeland as a state that admits diaspora members through the Law of Return and gathers them, not only as a cultural centre.

culture-before-state.rationale: The model assumes a state that already shapes culture and symbols for the ethnic nation.

scripture-judged-by-women.rationale: Feminist theology is outside the model.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: The model deals with state, land and symbols; Malaysia's Bumiputra policies in s2 point the other way but Israel and Estonia do not.

single-unit-for-people.rationale: Smooha says the state worked to break up Arab territorial contiguity and rejects minority territorial autonomy.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: A socialist definitional dispute unrelated to the model.

second-chamber.rationale: Legislative design is not addressed; the cases differ.

municipal-property.rationale: A municipalist doctrine unrelated to the model.

confederal-coordination.rationale: The model is of a unitary state controlled by the core nation.

faster-drug-approval.rationale: Drug regulation is outside the model.

ageing-research-funding.rationale: Research funding priorities are outside the model.

anonymous-payments.rationale: The security apparatus tracking threats suggests suspicion of untraceable payments, an inference only.

online-anonymity.rationale: Internet privacy is not covered, apart from the state's security concerns.

person-over-state.rationale: The ethnic nation, not the citizen, is the cornerstone of the state, which is mobilised for the nation's ends.

spiritual-nature.rationale: A philosophical-anthropology claim not in the model.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: Autonomy for minorities is limited and the majority controls the national legislature, so revocable powers fit.

dense-cities.rationale: Urban planning is not addressed, although Smooha mentions Jewish control of planning committees.

racial-group-interests.rationale: The ethnic nation organises the state to advance its own interests, and the minority is also allowed to struggle for its own, though the label is ethnic rather than racial.

racial-pride.rationale: The model builds on ethnic pride and nationalism, though the statement says race and ancestry rather than nation.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Not addressed; Smooha stresses defence but also a state of permanent threat.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Smooha lists language as one of three elements of the ethnic nation, but Jews are united by descent and religion across languages.

communal-electorates.rationale: Arab parties compete in the single national electorate, and Smooha does not describe separate communal rolls.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: Smooha reports Jewish fears of minority secession and patron states, but no belief in a foreign partition plot.

future-generations.rationale: Intergenerational environmental ethics is outside the model.

women-distinct-values.rationale: Difference feminism is not part of the model.

arms-reduction.rationale: Smooha says a high military capability is needed, so reduction is not favoured, but arms control is not discussed.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Secrecy in treaties is not discussed.

capital-controls.rationale: Financial regulation is outside the model.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: The state monopolises security forces, and Arabs are excluded from them; armed minority groups are treated as threats.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: The military is the instrument of the nation's survival and mobilisation.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Labour relations are unaddressed apart from Arab membership of the Histadrut.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Global economic reform is not addressed.

smash-state-machine.rationale: The model values the state as the instrument of the ethnic nation.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: Economic pluralism is not part of the model.

nature-as-capital.rationale: Natural-capital accounting is outside the model.

sacred-nation.rationale: The ethnic nation is the state's cornerstone but no source attributes sacredness to it.

internal-colonialism.rationale: Smooha notes minority land loss and state allocation disparities but does not use the term.

shared-human-nature.rationale: Smooha cites universal rights norms as compatible but the model takes no stance on human nature.

public-service-media.rationale: Smooha mentions state-funded Arab media but no media-independence doctrine.

religions-one-truth.rationale: The model concerns ethnic ownership of the state; a core nation's religion often marks its identity (Judaism in Israel), which sits poorly with a claim that all religions are one truth, inferred from that.

farm-price-support.rationale: Agricultural policy is outside the model; ethnic democracies range from subsidised to market farming, so no stance follows.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Inferred from the security-driven rationale of the model: Smooha stresses the majority's perceived existential threat, and the Israeli archetype keeps nuclear ambiguity.

workers-own-party.rationale: The model says nothing on class parties; adherents span labour and right-wing parties in Israel, Estonia and Latvia.

ban-fgm.rationale: Inferred: the model keeps a liberal-democratic procedural core with individual rights, and a ban is compatible with it; the sources do not discuss the practice.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Inferred from the model's grant of equal individual citizenship rights, though Smooha's sources do not address inheritance.

one-language-many-names.rationale: The model favours the core nation's language as the state language but does not address regional naming of one language.

pollution-tort-liability.rationale: Inferred: ethnic democracies are ordinary modern states with regulatory agencies, and nothing in the model favours replacing agencies with private suits.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.rationale: Inferred from the model's electoral democratic procedure; formal advisory seats for traditional leaders are not part of it.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: Environmental priorities are outside the model, and adherents hold no common view.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Criminal sentencing is not addressed by the model; adherents are split.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: The model has the core nation's language and culture shape the state and public life, and Estonia and Latvia are cited cases with language requirements for citizenship, so requiring immigrants to learn it fits.

no-compulsory-union.rationale: The model concerns who owns the state and not labour law; adherents split on union policy.

voter-id.rationale: Smooha's model has the state use controls on minorities for security, including citizenship and identity rules; ID rules fit its security logic, but the model does not address them directly.

religious-equal-recognition.rationale: Ethnic democracy gives the core ethnic nation's religion and culture a privileged place, and Smooha describes official status for the majority culture, so equal legal footing for every interpretation is not the model's logic; this is a mild inference about religion streams.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: Smooha defines ethnic democracy as democratic in procedure, with free elections and minority parties, while a core ethnic nation keeps control; this is the very feature that distinguishes it from ethnocracy.

premarital-sex.rationale: The model does not address sexual morality; adherents range from secular to religious.

internet-shutdowns.rationale: Smooha's model accepts security controls on the minority but the sources do not mention internet access; adherents are split.

negative-income-tax.rationale: Economic policy is outside the model; adherents on left and right both exist.

women-suffrage.rationale: Ethnic democracy is by definition democratic with universal voting rights; Smooha's standard subtype grants citizenship and voting to all, and women's rights are included in that.

religion-oppresses-women.rationale: The model says nothing on this; most adherents treat religion as part of the national identity rather than as oppressive.

race-social-construct.rationale: The model does not address it; adherents may accept the social construction of race while still defending a national core, so a split answer.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: The model does not address gender policy; adherents range widely.

homestead-ownership.rationale: The model says nothing on how property is acquired; inferred as neutral, though state land policy favouring the core nation is part of it.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Inferred from the security-first posture of ethnic democracies, notably Israel, towards external judgment; the model itself does not address courts.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: Inferred from the model's procedural, secular definition of democracy; scripture is not discussed, and defenders of the core nation's religion may differ.

gendered-self-government.rationale: The model does not address gender in minority self-government; adherents are split.

defend-planned-state.rationale: The model is a democratic regime with a market economy and no planned-state commitment; inferred from that.

indirect-election.rationale: The model concerns electoral inclusion of minorities, not the design of higher offices; no basis for inference.

national-church-status.rationale: In the model the core ethnic nation shapes the state's symbols and institutions, so a privileged status for its traditional religious body fits; inferred from that, as the statement is not discussed directly.

minority-territorial-autonomy.rationale: Inferred from the model's controls on minorities, which grant individual rights but inferior or no collective rights and treat minority territorial claims as a threat.

disputed-territory-plebiscite.rationale: Inferred from the model's security controls and its fear that minorities could secede or shift borders; plebiscites are not discussed.

keep-colonial-borders.rationale: Not addressed by the model; no basis for inference.

simple-living.rationale: Not addressed by the model; no basis for inference.

restrict-indigenous-settlement.rationale: The model's land and settlement controls favour the core nation, so restricting settlement in minority-majority regions runs against it; inferred from that.

equal-conscription.rationale: Israel conscripts Jewish women but largely exempts Arab citizens; adherents are split and the model does not address it.

missingStatements.text: A state may legitimately be defined as the state of one ethnic nation rather than of all its citizens.
missingStatements.rationale: This is the defining claim of the model: the ethnic nation, not the citizenry, is the cornerstone of the state, as Smooha states in his account of Slovakia, Estonia and Israel.

missingStatements.text: Political parties that deny the state's identity as the homeland of its dominant nation may be barred from elections.
missingStatements.rationale: Smooha cites Israeli provisions barring parties that deny Israel as the homeland of the Jewish people as part of the defensive democracy that protects the state's ethnic character.

missingStatements.text: Citizens who belong to a minority seen as hostile may be subject to special security surveillance and exempted from military service.
missingStatements.rationale: Smooha lists exemption of Arabs from service and the secret service's targeting of the minority among the control measures of the model.
missingStatements.declined: A description of control measures within one model (Israel) rather than a broadly contested position; too narrow for the bank.

notes: Smooha defends ethnic democracy as a lesser evil, a temporary necessity or compatible with universal minority rights; adherents differ between the 'improved' subtype (more cultural autonomy and representation) and the 'hardline' one. Critics (Yiftachel, Ghanem, Rouhana, Neuberger, Bishara) argue it is ethnocracy or semi-democracy. Many answers are low-confidence inferences because the model has no position on economic, moral or environmental questions.
